restaurants.name: Kamimura
restaurants.address: 190-4 Aza Yamada, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido 044-0081
restaurants.notes: Niseko's flagship fine-dining restaurant by chef Yuichi Kamimura (formerly Tetsuya's). Tasting menu only; book months ahead in peak season.

restaurants.name: Rakuichi Soba
restaurants.address: 431 Aza Niseko, Niseko-cho, Abuta District, Hokkaido 048-1511
restaurants.notes: Tiny 12-seat counter making hand-cut soba; featured by Anthony Bourdain. Lunch only; reservations essential.

restaurants.name: Bang Bang
restaurants.address: 188-24 Aza Yamada, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido 044-0081
restaurants.notes: Classic Hirafu yakitori counter; long queues at peak season. Walk-in only.

restaurants.name: Abucha 2
restaurants.address: 167-3 Aza Yamada, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido 044-0081
restaurants.notes: Cozy izakaya in lower Hirafu. Hot pot, sashimi, sake. Book a few days ahead.

restaurants.name: Ezo Seafoods
restaurants.address: 188-19 Aza Yamada, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido 044-0081 (Skye Niseko, ground floor)
restaurants.notes: Hokkaido oysters, scallops and crab in a casual bar setting at the base of Hirafu.

restaurants.name: Niseko Pizza
restaurants.address: 188-14 Aza Yamada, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido 044-0081
restaurants.notes: Wood-fired pizzas; reliable family-friendly option in Hirafu Village.

restaurants.name: An Dining
restaurants.address: Park Hyatt Niseko Hanazono, 328-36 Aza-Iwaobetsu, Kutchan, Hokkaido 044-0084
restaurants.notes: Hyatt-run kaiseki and Hokkaido beef restaurant. One of the few high-end options on the Hanazono side.

restaurants.name: The Barn by Odin
restaurants.address: 188-19 Aza Yamada, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido 044-0081
restaurants.notes: Wood-fired modern European with a strong wine list; under the AYA Niseko building.

restaurants.name: Tsubara Tsubara
restaurants.address: 190-15 Aza Yamada, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido 044-0081
restaurants.notes: Cheap, hearty soup curry — perfect post-ski lunch. Cash only.

restaurants.name: Graubünden Café
restaurants.address: 132-26 Aza Yamada, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido 044-0081
restaurants.notes: Long-running Swiss-style cafe; sandwiches, soups, baked goods. Great breakfast or take-away lunch stop.

restaurants.name: Kumo Bar
restaurants.address: 190 Aza Yamada, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido 044-0081
restaurants.notes: Speakeasy-style cocktail bar; good late-night stop after dinner.

restaurants.name: The Fridge Door Bar / Boot Bar & Grill
restaurants.address: 188-7 Aza Yamada, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido 044-0081
restaurants.notes: Apres-ski staple — burgers, beers and live music on weekends.

restaurants.name: Boyo-so Mountain Lodge (lunch)
restaurants.address: On the Niseko Annupuri ski area, mid-station
restaurants.notes: Old-school mountain hut for soup curry, ramen and a quiet beer mid-day.
